scope: Read-only source and original bytecode audit of TC6 BETA26 against alpha9.15. Mathematical candidate density, not measured natural-world yield.

original_rules.horizontal_positions: chunk minimum + 2 through +14, each axis inclusive, 13x13 candidate columns

cinnabar.placement: one ore block per successful stone replacement

quartz.placement: one ore block per successful stone replacement

amber.y: surfaceHeight - nextInt(25): surface-24 through surface inclusive
amber.placement: one ore block per successful stone replacement

original_rules.ore_host: BlockMatcher(Blocks.STONE): all states of old stone block, including granite/diorite/andesite. Modern deepslate is an explicit new substrate adaptation.

crystals.candidate_rejection: reject 1/3 at random, liquids, occupied nonreplaceable blocks, or no adjacent solid Material.ROCK face
crystals.stop: only after finishing the entire cube, and only when cumulative units > budget
crystals.drops: SIZE+1 (2..4 for naturally generated blocks), unaffected by Fortune or Silk Touch

original_rules.nether: generateOres returns immediately in dimension -1. The later t=1 Nether branch is unreachable. No TC ores/crystals from this method in Nether.
original_rules.other_dimensions: Original generic generator can run outside Overworld unless dimension/biome blacklist excludes it. Port currently explicitly restricts deposits to Overworld; do not silently claim all-dimension parity.

alpha915_discrepancies.cause: Current min seed=-63, max seed=58, same8 center attempts

alpha915_discrepancies.current: Always64, accumulates SIZE+1, and stops within a cube at units>=64
alpha915_discrepancies.original: Density-scaled64, accumulates SIZE, checks >limit after each complete cube

alpha915_discrepancies.current: Curated support tag excludes ordinary TC ores and many vanilla ores
alpha915_discrepancies.original: Any adjacent solid Material.ROCK face can support crystals

adaptation_recommendation.objective: Preserve expected candidate density per vertical layer, not merely original totals per chunk. More total underground volume therefore receives more candidates.
adaptation_recommendation.upper_limits: Keep original cinnabar top50 and quartz top63; extend only the lower bound to modern min build height. Do not substitute384 for256 into original fractional-height formulas.
adaptation_recommendation.scale_formula: expected attempts = legacy base * densityPercent/100 * modern candidate layer count / legacy candidate layer count
adaptation_recommendation.rounding_choice: For exact original control at minY=0 retain original Math.round(base*density); for added deep layers use unbiased stochastic rounding for fractional extra attempts, or a documented nearest-integer total. A two-band legacy+deep pass most directly preserves old upper-band intensity.
adaptation_recommendation.crystals: Surface varies by column, so a center-height or mean-height ratio is a documented approximation. Do not claim identical natural cave yield: modern cave geometry and flooded caves affect success independently.
adaptation_recommendation.amber: Do not scale20 upward simply because the world is deeper; it still samples a25-layer near-surface band. Add deepslate amber as a substrate variant, without inventing a blanket deep amber band.
adaptation_recommendation.variant_selection: Choose ore variant from the actual replaced block/tag, not from Y alone; stone and deepslate mix around Y0.
adaptation_recommendation.safety: Clamp sample positions and cluster writes to actual build bounds; respect ensureCanWrite in feature regions; do not modify pre-existing chunks or overwrite non-host blocks.

selected_implementation_policy.mode: Two independent vertical bands, preserving the original upper-band pass and adding a proportional lower-band pass.
selected_implementation_policy.ore_upper: Original0..50 or0..63, intersected with valid build range; original Math.round(base*density).
selected_implementation_policy.crystal_upper: Original0..max(5, localSurface-5)-1 centers, with guarded cluster writes outside build bounds.
selected_implementation_policy.crystal_lower: Normally minBuildY+1..-1 centers, with ratio to max(5, chunk-center surface-5). Low negative surface cases require clipping so centers do not rise above the intended underground interval.
selected_implementation_policy.rounding: Nearest-integer Math.round for each band separately; deliberate exact old upper pass, not an assertion of unbiased fractional density.
selected_implementation_policy.budget_semantics: Each band owns its own original-style budget, which may be exceeded by its final complete3x3x3cluster. Sum of budgets is not a hard global cap.
edge_cases: Keep seed0 in original upper band when minY=0; reject out-of-world neighbor writes rather than silently dropping that source layer.
Use actual substituted block to choose deepslate variant.

heightmap_verification.legacy_chain: World.func_175645_m (amu.l) -> World.c(x,z) -> Chunk.func_76611_b (axw.b) -> stored heightMap field_76634_f.
heightmap_verification.legacy_heightmap_predicate: Chunk.generateSkylightMap scans downward until IBlockState.getLightOpacity() !=0, then stores blockY+1.
heightmap_verification.water_proof: Both flowing_water and water registration call setLightOpacity(3), so original World.getHeight includes the top water surface.
heightmap_verification.modern_ocean_floor: OCEAN_FLOOR_WG uses state.blocksMotion(), therefore ignores water and measures the bottom.
heightmap_verification.decision: Switching ore/crystal surface reference to WORLD_SURFACE_WG restores water-surface behavior.
limits: Old heightmap is not literally first non-air: zero-opacity plants/glass differ.
Modern deposits run at underground_ores before trees; original Forge pass may see already-decorated canopies. Exact canopy-height equivalence is not claimed.
